snippet.title: Cannon Dinghies: Play Test 1 is Live!
snippet.description:
We've begun our first Play Test of Cannon Dinghies, starting with a handful of direct-keyed players to help us figure out some initial sharp edges. The test so far has been a huge success and helped us smash tons of bugs and UX issues. We know there are more to find!

We are going to be opening the flood gates on the Steam Play Test for a weekend of open testing soon, so join the Play Test on steam to be notified when it is open!

Join our Discord to offer feedback and suggestions or join the Play Test directly: https://discord.gg/AwfGEGuX

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4766060/Cannon_Dinghies/

We continue to develop our roadmap for this game, and we have a lot more planned!

~ DGS Team
